english.title: Aid / abet use of a vehicle without a vehicle licence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), aided, abetted, counselled and procured, **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), to use a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), which was unlicensed
english.legislation: Contrary to section 29(1) and (3) of the Vehicle Excise and Registration Act 1994 and section 44 of the Magistrates' Courts Act 1980.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
aid/abet/counsel/procure
a person to use
a vehicle
which was unlicensed

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Schedule 2 to the Act for descriptions of exempt vehicles.
(ii) See section 47 for restriction on the institution of proceedings.
(iii) Back duty will be ordered against the principal offender.
(iv) Statement of Facts procedure applies - for wording see end of document.
(v) For aid/abet keeping a vehicle on a road see offence wording H752.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY PRINCIPAL OFFENDER..) used (..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) which was unlicensed.

The defendant aided and abetted **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use the vehicle in that **(..SPECIFY ACTIONS..).

(A)_[The previous licence expired on **(..SPECIFY EXPIRY DATE..).]_
(B)_[The vehicle is unregistered in the UK. The date of entry is unknown.]_
(C)_[The vehicle is unregistered the UK. The date of entry was **(..SPECIFY DATE..).]_

The annual rate of duty at that time was **(..SPECIFY RATE OF DUTY..).

other.penalty:
An excise penalty being the greater of either:

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.
or
Five times the amount of duty chargeable in respect of the vehicle.

Time limit for prosecutions:
36 months
